text:
alice: CI red on a flaky unit in runtime tests, can someone help triage? Failing on macOS runners only.
alice: Job: https://ci.internal/reports/12345 (macos-latest)
alice: Test: TestServeShutdownCancellation
alice: Error excerpt: 
```
=== RUN   TestServeShutdownCancellation
--- FAIL: TestServeShutdownCancellation (0.27s)
    serve_test.go:142: expected shutdown to wait for inflight requests, got context canceled
```

alice: I ran `go test ./serve -run TestServeShutdownCancellation -race -parallel 8` locally but can't reproduce. Happens in CI ~1/30 runs.
ben: macOS only? linux reruns green?
alice: yes, linux and windows runners are green. macos is the one failing.
ci-bot: Build 12345 failed: TestServeShutdownCancellation — macos-latest — triggered by commit abcdef1
carol: @alice can you share the exact test flags (seed, -count, env) used by CI?
alice: CI runs `go test ./serve -run TestServeShutdownCancellation -count=1 -parallel=8` and sets `GOMAXPROCS=4`. No explicit seed.
dave: unseeded nondet = likely scheduling/race. Could be timer ordering on darwin threads. Have we ever seen `context canceled` vs `deadline exceeded` mismatch before?
emily: I can spin up the mac runner and hammer it with `-count=50` and `-race` to try reproduce. Want logs uploaded somewhere?
alice: yes please, upload to the job artifacts and paste link. Also try `GOMAXPROCS=2` and `GOMAXPROCS=8` to see sensitivity.
emily: on it. will kick off a matrix: counts 10/50, GOMAXPROCS 2/4/8, -race on/off.
ben: if it's timing we might get a repro with `-run TestServeShutdownCancellation -count=100 -parallel=8` and `-v`. If repros, bisect commit range: last green on main was abcdee0, first bad abcdef1.
carol: also add `-cover`? sometimes that nudges timings, though it may hide the issue. Maybe capture a goroutine dump on failure: `gstack` style or `SIGQUIT` dump.
dave: if emily repros, ask her to add a tiny sleep in shutdown to see if it changes failure rate. That will confirm timing window.
emily: update: started run (count=50, GOMAXPROCS=4, race). will report back in ~20m.
alice: thanks emily. if it repros, please also attach the failing stack trace. The CI artifact shows stack: `goroutine 42 [select]: runtime.gopark...` not super useful in artifact.
emily: quick update: after 22 runs, 1 failure. artifact: https://ci.internal/artifacts/12345/failure-22.txt
emily: failure stack shows shutdown path where a cancel happens before inflight wait completes. Looks like `waitGroup` returned early?
ben: could be a misuse: check for `defer wg.Done()` vs forgetting to wait on ctx-aware goroutine. Also look for `select { case <-ctx.Done(): return }` in request path — might race with shutdown signal.
carol: can we add small invariant asserts in the test to catch ordering: e.g., assert that server did call `shutdownStarted` before inflight goroutines return. If it fails, we can see ordering.
dave: for bisect: if emily can get a reliable reproduction we'll run `git bisect` across abcdee0..abcdef1. Otherwise might need stress test for a few hours.
emily: I also noticed mac runner has `ulimit -n` low; not sure if file descriptors/epoll differences on darwin affect timers.
alice: hmm good point. test opens a few sockets; fd exhaustion could make shutdown return err quickly. But logs show `context canceled` not `too many open files`.
ben: Next steps: 1) emily to run larger stress (count=200) and upload failing artifact if any. 2) if repros, carol/dave to try small test patch that inserts a 5ms sleep at shutdown boundary to confirm timing window. 3) if confirmed, bisect commit range and open PR to make shutdown deterministic for test (or use test hooks).
emily: run started for count=200 (GOMAXPROCS=4). will update link on failure.
alice: assigning to @emily for repro, @dave and @carol for triage if repro occurs. 
emily: ack. :thumbsup:
carol: thanks — I'll prep a minimal test-change branch to try the sleep + extra asserts so we can quickly try a candidate fix once repro is captured.
dave: cool. if anyone hits it locally, drop a `--- FAIL` snippet here and ping me.
alice: thanks all, keeping this thread pinned to the CI job.
ci-bot: build 12346 queued on macos-runner-7 (emily)
emily: quick FYI: after ~90 runs, 3 failures (non-deterministic traces). uploading a tar with 3 artifacts: https://ci.internal/artifacts/12346/fails.tar.gz
emily: first failure shows server goroutine stuck in `select` waiting for `shutdownC` while worker returned due to context cancel.
ben: good repro surface. carol/dave can you take a look at the trace in the tar and try the sleep hack?
carol: will do, thanks.
alice: appreciate it — will follow up in PR when we have a deterministic test fix. :pray:
